title: Time and Frequency Domain Viewer
description: The learner will interpret a frequency-domain bar chart by choosing, for 6 challenge sounds, the time-domain waveform that has the same frequencies and amplitudes, with at least 5 of 6 correct.

educational.learningObjective: The learner will interpret a frequency-domain bar chart by choosing, for 6 challenge sounds, the time-domain waveform that has the same frequencies and amplitudes, with at least 5 of 6 correct.

controls: Freq 1 and Freq 2 sliders: 100 to 1,000 Hz in 50 Hz steps (defaults 200 and 600 Hz)
Amp 1 and Amp 2 sliders: 0 to 1 in steps of 0.25 (defaults 1.0 and 0.5)
Start challenges / Next challenge / Show score button
A, B and C buttons: pick the matching waveform
pedagogical.model: Sum of sine components over a 20 ms window; spectrum bars measured by a DFT of 400 samples (50 Hz bins), single-sided amplitude 2|X_k|/N.
